digest.component_or_area: plan clarity analysis and P1 readiness gate
propositions: Empty parsed Acceptance Criteria checklist items (whitespace-only joined body) must fail standalone clarity and block P1 readiness deterministically
Unresolved sentinel tokens (TBD, TODO, FIXME, ???) in active execution sections must fail when they appear as values or assignments, but pass when preceded or accompanied by negation/removal terms
Plan structure parser must recognize standard checklist format within exact section headings and join continuation lines until the next checklist marker or H2 heading
Sentinel detection must ignore fenced code blocks and inline backtick code while enforcing case-insensitive matching for trigger words and suppression terms
Shared helper must be wired into both standalone clarity gate and plan-review P1 readiness gate without changing existing ticket-type exemptions or legacy compatibility score
